# SYNTHETIC test fixtures: FAKE data

Every file here is invented for offline tests. Symbols (FAKEA, FAKEB, FAKEBE, FAKEETF ...), prices,
names, people and links are made up. They copy only the *shape* (column names, JSON keys) of the
real sources as observed live on 2026-11-24, so the parsers are tested against the real field names.
Nothing here is market data.
